list.name: asset
list.label: 설비
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "raw", tag: "name", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "equipment" and (r.zone == "${zone}" or "${zone}" == "all"), start: -1d)

target.query: from(bucket: "raw") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "event" and r.level == "alert" and (r.zone == "${zone}" or "${zone}" == "all")) |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, text: r.title + (if exists r.text then " — " + r.text else ""), tags: r.zone }))

from(bucket: "raw") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "event" and r.level == "warn" and (r.zone == "${zone}" or "${zone}" == "all")) |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, text: r.title + (if exists r.text then " — " + r.text else ""), tags: r.zone }))

from(bucket: "raw") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "event" and r.level == "act" and (r.zone == "${zone}" or "${zone}" == "all")) |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, text: r.title + (if exists r.text then " — " + r.text else ""), tags: r.zone }))

panels.title: 건강도 (%)

targets.query: from(bucket: "raw") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "equipment" and r._field == "health" and (r.zone == "${zone}" or "${zone}" == "all") and r.name =~ /^${asset:regex}$/) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: r.name })) |> group(columns: ["_field"])

panels.description: 빨간 영역 = 예지정비 착수 검토 구간 (건강도 50% 미만)

targets.query: from(bucket: "raw") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "equipment" and r._field == "rul_min" and (r.zone == "${zone}" or "${zone}" == "all") and r.name =~ /^${asset:regex}$/) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: r.name })) |> group(columns: ["_field"])

from(bucket: "raw") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "equipment" and r._field == "risk10" and (r.zone == "${zone}" or "${zone}" == "all") and r.name =~ /^${asset:regex}$/) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: r.name })) |> group(columns: ["_field"])

from(bucket: "raw") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "equipment" and r._field == "cpk" and (r.zone == "${zone}" or "${zone}" == "all") and r.name =~ /^${asset:regex}$/) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: r.name })) |> group(columns: ["_field"])
